requestTabs.sections: Accessible label of the row of tabs of the request editor.
requestTabs.more: Label of the button that opens the tabs that do not fit.
requestTabs.loading: Accessible label shown while a tab loads.
requestTabs.examples: Button that opens the saved response examples of the request.
requestTabs.headerLabel: Singular name of a row of the Headers tab; used in the label of the bulk editor.
requestTabs.variableLabel: Singular name of a row of the Vars tab.
requestTabs.paramLabel: Singular name of a row of the Params tab.
requestTabs.labels.body: Tab: the body of the request.
requestTabs.labels.vars: Tab: variables of the request. Short for variables.
requestTabs.labels.extract: Tab: rules that copy values from the response into variables.
requestTabs.labels.tests: Tab: checks that run after the response arrives.
requestTabs.labels.settings: Tab: per-request settings such as timeout.
